description: This bar chart illustrates the Recall@10 metric for four different approaches. The horizontal axis displays the categories: “Ours”, “- critiquing”, “- scoring”, and “- ranking”, listed in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Recall@10”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.4, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1.  Four individual bars are present, each representing a different approach. The “Ours” bar is orange and extends to approximately 0.34. The “- critiquing” bar is blue and reaches a height of approximately 0.29. The “- scoring” bar is also blue, with a height of approximately 0.16. Finally, the “- ranking” bar is blue and extends to approximately 0.25. The bars are not visually emphasized beyond their color and height, and are arranged from left to right in the order listed on the horizontal axis.
